This piece combines an ultra-feminine aesthetic, provided by the refined, floral-patterned rebrodé lace, with military-inspired details, including washed cotton gabardine inserts that define the shape and lend striking material contrast. The dress is lined with a slip to make it more comfortable when worn and to offset the sheer effect of the lace.

description: Palazzo trousers in washed pure cotton gabardine with floral camouflage print that combines military inspiration with delicate botanical elegance. This model has belt loops and numerous pockets: a rear flap pocket, a large slanted pocket and two patch pockets with double-welt opening applied diagonally on the legs. These trousers epitomise PINKO's creative flair, striking the perfect balance of bold graphic style and feminine charm

name: Slim-Fit Jacket with Bustier Design
description: Slim-fit jacket in stretch Frescolana, a structured yet comfortable fabric inspired by menswear and reworked with ultra-feminine style by PINKO. Featuring two pockets with flap at the front, this garment has a punk-inspired bustier-style design with metal eyelets and self-tie laces at the front and back. The model is complete with tonal inner lining featuring the iconic Love Birds logo all over. Wear this jacket with the matching skirt for a head-to-toe look that won't go unnoticed

name: Striped Wool-Blend Mock-Turtleneck Sweater
description: Long-sleeved sweater with asymmetric mock turtleneck and slim-fit style accentuated by delicate gathering on the left side. Made from lightweight, yarn-dyed viscose- and wool-blend fabric that provides softness and warmth, this model features fine ribbing and a two-tone horizontal-stripe pattern. The final touch is given by the label with jacquard PINKO logo lettering on one of the sleeve ends. A modern garment that combines feminine charm and originality, elevating everyday outfits in style

name: Classic Long Sleeve Midi Knit Dress with Slit
description: Knit dress featuring a straight cut, round neckline, long sleeves, and soft decorative draping

name: Striped Long Sleeve Sweater Top
description: Long-sleeved sweater in heavyweight cotton jersey with two-tone horizontal-stripe print and plain-coloured ribbed crew neck. This model stands out for the glossy-effect overprint with Quiet Is The New Punk in graffiti-style lettering on the back and on the right sleeve, and for the label with macramé lace edging and PINKO logo lettering on the left sleeve, which provides an unmistakable nod to the brand's signature style codes. Wear this maritime-inspired garment for a comfortable look and timeless style.

name: Bustier Top with Spaghetti Straps
description: Bustier-inspired crop top with triangular cups and wide underband. This piece is made from Light Crinkle satin, a smooth, radiant fabric with delicate crinkles that lend movement and give it an exquisite feel, and is embellished with a tonal, Valenciennes-style lace trim along the cups. The design is complete with super-thin adjustable shoulder straps and concealed rear fastening. Wear this top with a pair of black trousers for a special party look that lets your femininity shine bright.

name: Open-Back Sleeveless Top
description: Sleeveless top with top layer in lightweight, floral-patterned Soft Lace and removable, plain-coloured lining. The garment has an elegant halterneck with integrated sash to tie as preferred, as well as georgette armholes accompanied by a velvet ribbon hand-threaded through the eyelets. If you love looks with a see-through effect, this model will undoubtedly suit you and give your evening looks a touch of refined sensuality

name: Bodysuit with Asymmetric Sleeves
description: Bodysuit in lightweight, comfortable jersey fabric with slim fit accentuated by delicate gathering. This garment stands out for its asymmetrical design—one long sleeve and one short sleeve—and can be styled in various ways thanks to the invisible double-slider zip fastening that crosses the chest and connects at the back. Wear this PINKO bodysuit with a slim-fit skirt or pair of flared trousers for an elegant outfit, and create a seductive cut-out effect by leaving the zips open in a way that suits you!

name: Ribbed Top with Lace Sleeves
description: Regular-fit, crew-neck sweater in lightweight and slightly elasticated ribbed viscose and wool yarn, featuring long sleeves in refined, floral-patterned stretch lace. Thanks to its versatile yet elegant design, it is perfect to wear under a jacket and with tailored trousers, or with a pair of special jeans.

name: Double-Breasted Slim-Fit Wool-Blend Jacket
description: Jacket in stretch wool-blend fabric with vertical wavy-effect herringbone weave, elasticated lining for the main body and jacquard lining for the sleeves. The design of this slim-fit model includes padded shoulders, a cinched waist that flatters the female figure, and a double-breasted closure with two buttonholes and buttons visible on one side only. The jacket also features peak lapels, a small welt pocket on the chest and two pockets with flap at the front, and is complete with elegant slits at the cuffs and two overlapping slits at the sides on the back for greater freedom of movement. The final touch is provided by the lingerie-inspired macramé lace logo label at the end of one of the sleeves. A classic piece for any woman's wardrobe, reworked by PINKO and designed to make you stand out with class, even on the most formal occasions.

name: Stretch Wool-Blend Tailored Shorts
description: Slim-fit tailored shorts made from herringbone-woven stretch wool-blend fabric. This model features refined pressed creases down the front and back, slanted side pockets and buttoned double-welt rear pockets, and is finished with a lingerie-inspired macramé lace label featuring the iconic PINKO logo lettering at the back. This garment, destined to become your all-purpose pair for various occasions, combines style and comfort

name: Wide-Leg Jeans with Side Slits
description: Five-pocket, wide-leg jeans in very soft black cotton and lyocell denim with concealed zip fastening and off-centre button at the front. This model stands out for the deep slits along the outer side of the legs, which provide a bold touch, and for the small, sparkling jewel detail on the openings. A modern garment that combines feminine charm and originality, elevating everyday outfits in style.

name: Oversized Poplin Shirt with Removable Tie and Polka Dots
description: Oversized, straight-fit shirt in lightweight pure viscose muslin with micro polka-dot print all over. This garment features a curved hem and long sleeves with a dropped shoulder and French cuff fastened with two shiny metal cufflinks in the shape of round studs. The design is complete with concealed fastening at the front, a patch with the PINKO logo lettering embroidered in italics on the collar and a removable tie made from contrasting viscose crêpe de Chine. Transitioning effortlessly from office to evening events, this garment—reworked by PINKO—is a staple for any woman's wardrobe.

name: Oversized Blouson Jacket with Drawstring
description: Blouson jacket in lightweight, technical, water-repellent microfibre canvas with soft, peachskin-like feel. This model has an oversized fit accentuated by the '80s-evoking construction of the raglan sleeves, a stand-up collar with drawstring and cord lock that contains a removable hood, and a drawstring down the back that gathers the volume to create a draped effect. The jacket also features an elasticated hem and cuffs, two-way zip fastening at the front and slanted front pockets, one of which has a clasp-detachable leather-effect pull finished with a metal version of the iconic Love Birds logo. Wear this jacket as part of an everyday outfit, or with jeans, to herald in the new season with a touch of style that won't go unnoticed.

name: Wide-Leg Check Palazzo Trousers
description: Wide-leg palazzo trousers with pressed pleat down the centre of the legs, which is more pronounced at the front and more subtle at the back. Made from yarn-dyed wool-blend fabric with a Prince of Wales-inspired check pattern, this model can be worn in two ways: with the waist buttoned for a high-waisted style, or with the button undone and the waist folded down for a more relaxed look that reveals a rebrodé lace trim. The design is finished with a lingerie-evoking macramé lace logo label on the back and a number of functional details such as slanted pockets, a double-welt pocket on the back, and zip and button fastening. Wear this pair with its matching jacket for a head-to-toe look that's ideal for formal occasions or pair with more casual garments for an everyday outfit that doesn't sacrifice style.

name: Nappa Leather-Effect Pencil Skirt
description: Straight-fit, calf-length pencil skirt in nappa leather-effect coated fabric. This garment features more functional details, including practical side pockets and invisible zip fastening on one side, and more decorative touches like a central slit at the back and small rear flaps with press stud. Try pairing with a slim-fit turtleneck top for a more elegant look, or with a relaxed-fit sweater to experiment with volume.

name: Cropped Check Long Sleeve Shirt with Tie
description: Oversized, straight-fit cropped shirt made from yarn-dyed cotton canvas embellished with all-over check pattern. This model features wide long sleeves and buttoned cuffs, a rear yoke, a wide box pleat, mother-of-pearl button fastening and a small patch pocket on the left side at the front finished with the PINKO logo lettering embroidered in italics. The distinctive feature of this shirt, inspired by menswear and reworked with ultra-feminine style by PINKO, is the removable tie, made from satin and finished with a tip embellished with studs of various shapes and hand-embroidered baguette-shaped stones. This garment, destined to become your all-purpose pair for various occasions, combines style and comfort.

name: Regular-Fit Tweed Vest with Check Pattern
description: Regular-fit vest in wool-blend tweed embellished with classic Buffalo check pattern—a nod to the grunge style of the '90s. This model features lightly padded cap shoulders, a slightly gathered elasticated hem, side pockets with press stud and zip fastening at the front. Wear this vest with the matching mini skirt and a pair of combat boots for a bold, feminine PINKO look!

name: Wrap Mini Skirt with Check Pattern
description: Slightly flared mini skirt with wraparound front closure fastened with concealed press stud and two leather-effect coated fabric straps with adjustable, logo-branded roller buckle. The garment is made from wool-blend tweed embellished with the classic Buffalo check pattern, in a nod to the grunge style of the '90s, while the waist and edge of the front panel are finished with subtle hand-worked fringing. Wear this mini skirt with a pair of combat boots and a turtleneck for a bold, feminine PINKO look!

name: Long Slip Dress with Front Knot
description: Slim-fitting yet fluid long slip dress, made from soft fabric that combines the comfort of jersey and the lustre of satin. Perfect as part of a bold evening outfit with an elegant touch, this model features a halterneck with V-shaped front opening and open upper back, a knotted detail and gathers that create two small cut-outs, and thin, metal aglet-tipped ribbons to tie at the back. The two side slits at the front and refined gathered effect at the back give the dress extra sensuality, while the invisible zip fastening at the side helps keep the silhouette clean.

name: Cropped Check Tweed Collarless Jacket
description: sophisticated Parisian flair with a modern Italian edge in the PINKO Geum Cropped Tweed Jacket. Meticulously engineered from a premium, wool-infused woven tweed, this timeless silhouette showcases a striking, multi-tonal red and black checkered motif. Reimagining classic tailoring, the jacket features a minimalist collarless crewneck design and structured shoulders that fall into a contemporary, clean-cut cropped hemline. Completed with elegant raw-edge frayed trim and twin front flap pockets, this versatile piece adds instant textural contrast and polished luxury to any capsule wardrobe.

name: Double-Breasted Wool Jacket with Jewel Buttons
description: Clean-cut, oversized, double-breasted jacket in Metal Wool, a virgin wool fabric with metallic fibres that provide a touch of irregular, dynamic shine that shimmers in different ways with every movement. The model features peak lapels, a small welt pocket on the chest and front pockets with flap, and is embellished with two faceted glass jewel buttons that accentuate the garment's radiant shine and sophistication. This jacket, unlined to showcase the quality of the yarn and finished with bound seams that demonstrate PINKO's attention to detail, is perfect for a modern, sophisticated tailored-style look with its matching trousers.

name: Check Wool-Blend Cropped Overshirt
description: Cropped, relaxed-fit shacket with flap-adorned shaped patch pockets on the chest, classic collar and cuffs with two buttons. Made from yarn-dyed wool-blend fabric with a Prince of Wales-inspired check pattern, this model also features refined gathering on the rear yoke for extra volume, and logo-branded buttons on the front and pocket flaps. The design is finished with a lingerie-evoking macramé lace logo label on the back. A PINKO-signature reimagining of a staple garment for women, which can be styled in various ways.

description: PINKO — Corduroy Wide-Leg Trousers. Available in Bordeaux.

name: Oversized Long Sleeve Shirt with Check Pattern
description: Oversized shirt in yarn-dyed viscose twill processed from staple fibres for softness, lightness and breathability, and embellished with classic check pattern reimagined with a striking fade effect by PINKO. This model features contrasting, plain-coloured cotton poplin inserts under the collar tips, along the front closure with two rows of mother-of-pearl buttons, and on the double cuffs with mother-of-pearl buttons. Ideal for creating daytime looks, the shirt is complete with patch pockets on the chest, a rounded hem that is longer at the back, and a rear yoke with two pleats that lend volume and movement.

name: Relaxed-Fit Wool Sweater with Maxi Diamonds
description: Relaxed-fit sweater with long raglan sleeves. Crafted from fine wool and cashmere yarn, this model is embellished with a maxi diamond motif in punk-style colours and made special by a series of hand-sewn stitches and openwork details that give it a used effect. The final touch is given by the label with jacquard PINKO logo lettering on the back.

name: Sleeveless Midi Slip Dress with Lace Bands
description: Sleeveless midi dress in fluid-feeling, silk-like acetate fabric with striking, slightly crinkled texture and tonal floral jacquard motif all over. This slip features spaghetti straps that adjust at the back and is embellished with scalloped rebrodé lace trims on the front of the bust, on the skirt, along the V-neck at the front, on the straight neck at the back, on the front of the straps and on the hem. The sheer effects and lingerie-inspired silhouette make this dress the ideal choice for a special evening look

name: Sleeveless Ribbed Top with Sheer Love Birds Logo
description: Sleeveless, slim-fit, crew-neck top made from lightweight, ribbed merino wool yarn. The front features the iconic Love Birds logo in the form of sheer inlay made with a dévoré technique that fully expresses the brand's DNA. A wardrobe staple reworked by PINKO, ideal for everyday outfits that are both functional and feminine.

Embrace sporty style with this practical, versatile piece, to wear in your free time or for more casual occasions.

Wear these shorts with their matching blazer to give the classic suit a contemporary update.

name: Wide-Leg Jeans with Studded Belt and Turn-Up Cuffs
description: Five-pocket jeans in pure cotton blue denim with medium wash and slight fading for a delicate worn effect. Scan the QR code on the tag and watch the video with three different ways to wear: beltless for a cleaner and more relaxed look, high-waisted with the belt tightened for a paper-bag effect, or with the belt adjusted at the side for a loose, low-waisted fit.

name: Silk Vest Top with Lace Neckline
description: Vest top with second skin-like slim fit. This garment is made from a fine yarn that combines the warmth and softness of wool and cashmere with the fluidity and natural lustre of silk, and is embellished with a lingerie-inspired lace insert with raw-cut edges along the plunging V-neck at the front. The final touch is given by the label with jacquard PINKO logo lettering on the back

name: Oversized Hooded Fleece Jacket
description: Oversized jacket with striking cape-like design, made from soft pure cotton fleece. Fastened with a zip at the front and lined with cotton jersey for extra comfort, this garment features wide, asymmetric elbow-length sleeves and a comfortable hood that can be adjusted via the original jewel chain-embellished drawstring. This cape is also customised with an unmistakable PINKO hallmark: the Love Birds logo and metallic-effect printed brand lettering on one of the two vertical-welt pockets. Embrace sporty style with this practical, versatile piece, to wear in your free time or for more casual occasions

name: Oversized Poplin Cotton Long Sleeve Shirt with Print
description: Oversized shirt in pure cotton poplin with mother-of-pearl button fastening at the front. This model features wide long sleeves with a French cuff fastened with two shiny metal cufflinks, while the back features a box pleat that provides extra volume and the words Quiet Is The New Punk—inspired by the slogan of the collection—starting from the yoke and extending along one sleeve. The design is complete with the PINKO logo lettering embroidered on the collar.

name: Relaxed-Fit Milano-Knit Overshirt
description: Overshirt with relaxed fit that is wider at the shoulders, featuring metal buttons on the front closure, the two welt pockets on the chest and the strap at the bottom. Made from technical, full Milano-knit stretch viscose fabric, this model also stands out for the delicate gathering on the front and elegant pleats on the rear yoke. A PINKO-signature reimagining of a staple garment for women, which can be styled in various ways.

The final touch is given by the label with jacquard PINKO logo lettering on the back. Understated and contemporary, this model will become a real all-purpose staple in your wardrobe.

A wardrobe staple reworked by PINKO, ideal for everyday outfits that are both functional and feminine.

This model features a wide fold-down collar, two vertical side pockets and two-way zip fastening, as well as fisherman's rib stitching on the collar, cuffs and hem. A versatile, modern garment ready to elevate your everyday outfits with that signature PINKO style.

name: Semi-Glossy Canvas Padded Shacket
description: Padded shacket in semi-glossy, silk-like technical canvas with patent-effect buttons and inserts. This slim-fit model features press-stud fastening at the front and on the cuffs, two in-seam side pockets with zip, belt loops at the waist and an elasticated belt embellished with a Love Birds Diamond Cut logo buckle. On the back, the patch featuring the iconic Love Birds embroidered with tonal thread completes the design. Transitioning effortlessly from office to evening events, this outerwear piece combines PINKO's creative flair and craftsmanship.

name: Canvas Palazzo Trousers with Zip and Cargo Pockets
description: Palazzo trousers in technical canvas with strikingly soft, peachskin-like feel. This model features practical pockets: two utility-style pockets with flap and buttons on the legs, and two rear welt pockets, one of which has a contrasting pull with metal Love Birds logo appliqué. The garment also has an elasticated waist with fabric drawstring and a full-length zip down the legs for easy opening. Give a touch of lightness to your everyday outfits in the cold season with these trousers with a versatile, feminine vibe.

name: Short Sleeve T-Shirt with Lace Top
description: Short-sleeved, crew-neck T-shirt in soft, durable pure cotton jersey with overlapping lingerie-style lace top with spaghetti straps and scalloped hem, attached at the shoulders and adjustable via a drawstring at the back. This regular-fit model is finished with the PINKO logo lettering embroidered in italics on the chest. Wear this garment with your favourite jeans for a modern look that won't sacrifice femininity.

name: Overshirt with Check Pattern and Sequins
description: Oversized overshirt in technical stretch fabric with crepe de chine lining. This model is embellished with a check pattern and see-through sequins all over for a refined wet effect, and is complete with two patch pockets on the chest and button fastening down the front. A PINKO-signature reimagining of a staple garment for women, which can be styled in various ways

name: Nappa Leather-Effect Slim-Fit Flared Trousers
description: Slim-fit flared trousers in nappa leather-effect coated technical fabric. This model features slanted pockets, belt loops and a concealed side zip, while the ergonomic seams along the back of the legs ensure a better fit.

name: Relaxed-Fit Faux Fur Cropped Jacket
description: Cropped, relaxed-fit jacket with cosy wide hood. This garment is made from soft, fur-effect Aspen fabric with a suede-effect interior, and features an elasticated insert at the hem that creates light gathering and adds volume. This women's jacket, ideal for cold early-season weather, is complete with side welt pockets and front zip fastening with a pull featuring the PINKO logo lettering

name: Short Faux Fur Cape
description: Short cape made from soft, fur-effect Aspen fabric with a very pleasant feel. Featuring inner lining to make it even more comfortable when worn, this garment has short sleeves, front pockets and a cosy high neck equipped with a crocodile-print faux leather strap with roller buckle. This outerwear is ideal for wearing on cooler early-season days in the open air with maximum comfort without sacrificing a touch of style

name: Short Faux Fur Bomber Jacket
description: Short bomber jacket featuring a wraparound raised collar and a comfortable rib-knit hem and cuffs. The garment is made from soft, mink fur-effect Aspen fabric and is finished with contrasting, crocodile-print faux leather appliqués on the front closure with two-way zip and on the welt pockets at the sides. Ideal for braving the cold in style, this women's jacket is complete with jacquard fabric inner lining embellished with the Love Birds logo—a hallmark of PINKO's DNA

name: Croazia Love Birds Monogram Jacquard Poncho
description: Envelop yourself in effortless Italian luxury with the PINKO Croazia Poncho. Beautifully knitted from a soft, dense premium wool-blend jacquard, this flowing outerwear piece showcases a striking all-over monogram pattern seamlessly integrating the brand's iconic Love Birds motif. Designed with an effortless, fluidly draped asymmetrical hemline and open-front styling, it serves as the ultimate transitional layering piece. The rich chocolate brown base is elegantly contrasted by warm beige borders and script detailing, lending a sophisticated, cozy warmth to any autumn or winter ensemble.

name: Balloon-Fit Jeans with Coated Canvas inserts
description: Balloon-fit jeans in black cotton and lyocell denim, overdyed in black and featuring coated canvas inserts. This model has two side pockets and two rear patch pockets, one of which includes a workwear-style loop, and features a zip and tab with two buttons at the bottom of each leg to adjust the fit. Modern and versatile, these jeans will become the star of your everyday outfits, showcasing every ounce of your character.

name: Carrot-Fit Wrap Trousers
description: Carrot-fit trousers in cupro and viscose twill with strikingly soft, peachskin-like feel. This model features belt loops and a rear welt pocket, and fastens at the front with a button and lowered off-centre zip, creating a wraparound-style effect and continuing with a matching-fabric belt.

name: Wide-Leg Wrap Trousers
description: Elegant wide-leg trousers featuring a distinctive front construction with wrap-style panel that fastens on one side. The garment is made from a stretch viscose fabric with a distinctly fluid feel. The inner fabric lining ensures maximum comfort when worn. The design is completed by the belt loops, the hidden front fastening and the welt pocket on the back. Pair these trousers with a blazer in the same fabric for a suit or with a shirt for a slightly but not overly formal look.

name: Short Sleeve T-Shirt with Love Birds Jewel Detail
description: Crew-neck short-sleeved T-shirt in soft cotton jersey. The minimalist shape of this model is enhanced by the jewel embroidery featuring shiny crystals of different shapes and colours on the chest, which bring the unmistakable Love Birds logo to life. Wear this T-shirt with your favourite jeans to give your casual outfits a sparkling touch in pure PINKO style.

name: Long Sleeve Crew Neck Sweater with Love Birds Logo
description: Long-sleeved crew-neck sweater in extremely light and versatile pure merino wool. The front features the iconic Love Birds logo in the form of sheer inlay made with a dévoré technique that fully expresses the brand's DNA. The back of the garment, on the other hand, features exposed top-stitching that resembles the shape of a yoke. Rib-knit crew-neck, hem and cuffs. The piece has undergone finishing tests to minimise the possible formation of pilling, ensuring greater fabric softness and durability.

name: Unstructured Regular-Fit Jacket with Polka-Dot Insert
description: Unstructured, regular-fit blazer in fluid-feeling fabric with peak lapels, small cuff slits and single-breasted, single-button closure. The undisputed star of this piece, however is the men's vest-inspired back part featuring a refined twill jacquard insert with tone-on-tone polka-dot motif. This garment is complete with flap pockets at the sides, small welt pockets on the chest, two rear slits and a matching rear belt that can be tightened to adjust the fit. Wear this jacket on formal occasions for an elegant modern look with that signature PINKO style.

name: Capirai Crystal-Embellished Cotton Poplin Long Sleeve Shirt
description: Transform your tailored classics with the statement-making elegance of the PINKO Capirai shirt. Expertly crafted from crisp, premium 100% cotton poplin, this button-down blouse redefines traditional tailoring with a dramatic plunge V-neckline framed by opulent, multi-strand rhinestone clusters and metallic embroidery. The relaxed, oversized silhouette is balanced by clean dropped shoulders and structured buttoned cuffs, lending an effortless boyfriend-fit feel to an inherently glamorous piece. Complete with a classic pointed collar and a curved high-low hemline, it easily transitions from chic daywear to refined evening ensembles.

name: Faded-effect T-shirt with Love Birds Logo
description: Infuse your off-duty wardrobe with a contemporary streetwear edge using this PINKO cropped t-shirt. Crafted from premium heavyweight cotton jersey, it features a distinct vintage-inspired "old-wash" finish that gives it a unique, lived-in character. The center front is detailed with a tonal, structurally embossed emblem featuring the brand's iconic Love Birds motif and signature branding. Cut into a relaxed, boxy silhouette with oversized mid-length sleeves and a timeless crew neck, it strikes the perfect balance between luxury comfort and effortless style.

name: Cotton T-Shirt with Wide Sleeves and Love Birds Logo
description: Crew-neck T-shirt in pure cotton jersey with wide short sleeves. Complete with dropped shoulder seams for a modern, relaxed silhouette, this knit is neatly anchored by structured ribbing at the cuffs and hem to hold its shape perfectly all day.

name: Sleeveless Knit Cardigan Vest

description:
Eclose by Iro is a masterfully tailored long dress, exuding an air of understated sophistication. Crafted from an exceptionally soft, supple fabric with a delicate sheen, this silhouette-skimming piece gently caresses the contours of the body. The halter neckline with a tastefully rounded edge elegantly highlights the shoulders and elongates the neck, while refined draping at the waist subtly enhances the figure and radiates poise.

The absence of visible embellishments or logos accentuates the dress’s purity of form, allowing the artistry of Parisian-inspired minimalism to take center stage. Minimal yet captivating, the Eclose dress is the epitome of modern luxury—sensual, versatile, and impeccably constructed.

name: High-waisted Mid-Length Skirt with Slit
description:
Introducing the Emeraude skirt by Iro—an exquisite interpretation of modern Parisian chic. This mid-length skirt gently tapers along a refined silhouette, finishing with a subtly asymmetrical hem; the front is elegantly shorter than the back, creating a dynamic yet sophisticated effect. The high waist, adorned with delicate ruching and gathering, sculpts and flatters the form while lending dimensional elegance to the design.

Crafted from a soft, lightly lustrous, and gently stretchable fabric, the Emeraude skirt drapes gracefully, ensuring both comfort and luxurious wear. Its smooth, unembellished surface exudes understated sophistication, with the artistic draping at the waist and hips serving as the signature embellishment.

name: Straight-Leg Silhouette Trousers
description:
Elevate your wardrobe with these timeless tailored trousers, designed for a sleek and polished look. Crafted with a clean, structured silhouette, they feature a flattering high-rise waistband and sharp front pleats that create a refined, elongating effect. The straight-leg cut ensures versatility, making them perfect for both professional settings and elevated everyday wear.
Made from a smooth, high-quality fabric, these trousers offer comfort without compromising on style. Pair them effortlessly with a crisp shirt for the office or a relaxed knit for a modern, off-duty outfit.

name: Python-Printed Wide Leg Jeans

name: Wide-Leg High-rise Classic Trousers
description:
The Kalei wide-leg trousers by Iro epitomize an interplay of Parisian sophistication and modern flair. Constructed from a luxuriously smooth fabric—a refined wool blend—these formal trousers drape with effortless elegance, reflecting Iro’s devotion to exquisite tailoring.

The high-rise silhouette is accentuated by front pleats, adding sculptural volume and a striking, geometric touch. A deep charcoal gray hue, punctuated by narrow, vertical light pinstripes, elevates the classic wide-leg design with understated distinction. The waistband boasts elongated, avant-garde elements, imparting a unique designer signature, while side slit pockets and rear welt pockets offer refined practicality

name: Long Printed Classic Coat
description:
Discover the epitome of refined sophistication with the 'Iglia' Coat by Iro – a distinguished creation from the acclaimed Parisian maison founded by Arik and Laurent Bitton. This long, classic overcoat boasts a relaxed silhouette and gently broadened shoulders, artfully complemented by traditional lapels, lending an air of enduring elegance.

Exquisitely tailored from a sumptuous blend of premium acrylic, wool, alpaca, cotton, polyamide, and polyester, the fabric’s rich, melange tweed structure in brown is beautifully interwoven with black and white threads, creating a striking, irregular pattern reminiscent of artisanal craftsmanship. The robust textile is ideally suited to the autumn and winter seasons, offering warmth as well as a tactile sense of luxury.

Impeccable details, such as two horizontal flap pockets and a single-breasted button fastening, evoke minimalist chic while ensuring practical elegance. This statement piece artfully channels the effortless Parisian flair for which Iro is celebrated.

name: Short Leather Jacket with Pockets
description:
Presenting the Dunea Leather Jacket by Iro—a statement piece that redefines contemporary sophistication. This jacket boasts a short, loosely tailored silhouette with accentuated shoulders and a tapered hem, underscored by a broad, ruched elastic band for an effortlessly modern, oversized effect. Crafted from premium lamb leather with a subtle luster, its smooth, monochromatic finish exudes minimalist elegance.

Signature design elements include a full-length metal zipper with a prominent leather pull, two generously sized flap patch pockets at the chest, and wide sleeves narrowed at the wrists with polished zip closures. The back features two decorative buckle straps and intricate stitched detailing at the hem, emphasizing its refined, structured fit. Lined with breathable viscose, this jacket harmonizes elevated design with everyday comfort, embodying Iro's Parisian-inspired flair.

description: Trousers in yarn-dyed fil-à-fil cotton- and linen-blend slub fabric with slightly irregular and mottled texture that creates a refined two-tone optical effect. Understated and contemporary, this model will become a real all-purpose staple in your wardrobe.

name: High-Waisted Wide-Leg Cargo Pants
description: Trousers made of taffeta-like technical canvas, with side inserts made of organza ripstop for a combination of strength and transparency. This garment features an adjustable drawstring at the leg hem, two side pockets, two back patch pockets and two workwear-effect pockets with flap and press studs down the legs. A versatile, modern garment that reinterprets the streetwear spirit with a PINKO twist.

name: Slim-Fit Midi Dress With Jewel Embroidery
description: A tank top with a wide round neckline, crafted from viscose crepe with a fluid, flowing hand. This piece is a true gem, thanks to its distinctive pinstripe-inspired design, achieved by alternating small cube-shaped metal elements and hand-embroidered crystals. Thanks to its versatile yet elegant design, it's the perfect under-jacket paired with tailored trousers, but also with a special pair of jeans.

name: Midi Wrap Dress With Belt
description: Midi dress with small cap sleeves, made from panama fabric reminiscent of rustic linen for an elegant, relaxed look. Boasting a slim-fitting sheath silhouette and convenient rear zip fastening to help put it on, this style has a wrap-around design, elegant front pleats, a faux pocket on the left side and a plunging V-neck with jacket-like lapel collar. Completing this dress, ideal for a cocktail party or an evening date, are the central slit at the back and removable waist belt embellished with gold-coloured eyelets and buckle.

description: Lined jacket in fluid-effect panama stretch fabric reminiscent of rustic linen. This garment features peak lapels, two front flap pockets, a small welt pocket on the chest and refined slits at the cuffs, and is complete with a single-breasted two-button fastening. description: Straight-leg trousers in fluid-effect panama stretch fabric reminiscent of rustic linen. This garment features rear welt pockets, zip and button fastening, and a removable matching belt with gold-coloured eyelets and buckle. Understated and contemporary, this model will become a real all-purpose staple in your wardrobe

name: Crop Top With Ruffle And Openwork Pattern
description: Cropped sleeveless top in pure cotton poplin, featuring a soft flounce at the hem, a deep V-neck at the front and back, and thin ribbons to be tied behind the neck for customised styling. Featuring a side zip fastening to make it easy to put on, the garment is enhanced by all-over broderie anglaise detailing that creates an elegant geometric interplay of full and openwork embroidery, and is equipped with an inner cotton lining at the bodice to attenuate the sheer effect. This garment, destined to become your all-purpose pair for various occasions, combines style and comfort.

name: Semi-lined Cotton Trousers With Openwork Motif
description: Semi-lined pure cotton poplin trousers with refined welt pockets and a hidden side zip. This garment, with a wide-leg design, is enhanced by broderie anglaise detailing all over, creating an elegant geometric interplay of full and openwork embroidery. This garment is ready to embellish your summer outfits, combining style and comfort.

name: Denim Jeans With Lace Side Band
description: Trousers in lightweight black pure cotton denim with slightly flared legs. The functionality of the garment, provided by the elasticated waist and rear welt pockets, is enhanced by lace bands down the outer sides for a refined PINKO-signature touch. Completing the model is a small metal appliqué with the Love Birds logo on one of the back pockets. Pair these bottoms with a white shirt for an elegant look, or wear them with a T-shirt for a casual outfit.

name: Straight Leg Jeans With Contrasting Fold-Down Waist
description: Women's five-pocket jeans with a wide, straight leg and a fixed turn-up hem. This garment is made from pure cotton denim with a super-bleached wash to obtain a pristine white shade all over, except for the inside of the waist and leg cuffs, which provide contrasting colour as a result. Thanks to the shorter zip, inner hook and press stud, this model be worn two ways: with a regular rise for a more classic look, or with a low rise with the waistband turned down for a touch of that PINKO-signature refined originality. Iconic brand hallmarks give the design a custom touch: a laser-cut Love Birds logo on one of the rear pockets and PINKO logo lettering on the inside of the waist at the back.

name: Asymmetrical Ruffled Camisole Top
description: A stylish one-shoulder top featuring gathered, ruffled details, often listed as the "Susie Top" or "Ruffled one-shoulder top". It typically features an asymmetric design, a thin strap

name: Sleeveless Ribbed Knit Polo Top
description: Sleeveless top in lightweight, ribbed stretch rayon, a soft, compact fabric with a shiny appearance that enhances the female figure. This style features a refined stand-up collar that ties at the front in a bandana style and a front fastening with buttons. The final touch is given by the label with jacquard PINKO logo lettering on the back. A versatile piece that is easy to wear with a pair of jeans or layer under a jacket for a casual look.

name: Long Ribbed Dress With Bandana Collar
description: Long dress with close-fitting yet comfortable silhouette elevated by its glossy ribbed fabric. Boasting a sleeveless design, this model features central button fastening on the front of the bodice, a flowing skirt with a wavy-effect hem, and a truly eye-catching, slightly raised collar with bandana-inspired strips that can either be tied into a basic knot for a fresh look or into a bow for a more feminine result. The final touch is given by the label with PINKO logo lettering on the back.

name: Long Slip Dress With Rhinestones
description: Long slip dress with spaghetti straps, loose neckline with draping at the front and back-revealing wide round neckline at the rear, punctuated only by two ribbons that tie in the middle. Made from georgette fabric with a refined matte finish, which delicately caresses the body and delivers a light, fluid silhouette, this model is embellished with shiny rhinestones dotted all over in a way that encapsulates PINKO's DNA as a brand. Feminine but with bold character, this dress is destined to become the star or your looks for special evenings and exclusive ceremonies.

name: Sleeveless Top With Lace Details
description: Sleeveless crew-neck top in cotton jersey, featuring sheer inserts and lace details. Thanks to its versatile yet elegant design, it's perfect to wear under a jacket and with tailored trousers, or with a pair of special jeans.

name: Relaxed Fit Denim Utility Bermuda Shorts With Belt
description: Relaxed-fit Bermuda shorts in pure cotton denim with medium wash and fading for an eye-catching worn effect. As well as the jean-typical five pockets and concealed zip and button fastening, this model features two utility pockets with buttoned flap on the legs, an elasticated waist with belt loops and a matching-fabric belt finished with raised PINKO logo lettering.

name: Cotton Long-cut Jacket With Belt
description: Long-cut jacket made from pure cotton twill with a crinkled yet fluid feel, an ideal fabric to follow the silhouette without constricting it. This garment has a cotton inner lining for greater comfort when worn, and features a pointed collar, a front button fastening, three-button cuffs and a matching, removable belt to tie at the waist. Ready to complete your everyday outfits in pure PINKO style, this jacket will become the must-have outerwear for your wardrobe.

name: Cotton Fluid Long Shorts
description: Thick and flowing long shorts in pure cotton twill with refined front pleats, featuring a matching fabric belt with tonal double buckle to be tied at the front. The garment also features side pockets, rear welt pockets, flap and button pockets along the legs and an elasticated waistband at the sides. The inner lining provides added comfort when worn. Elegant and contemporary, this model will become a real all-purpose staple in your wardrobe.

name: Amati Rhinestone Detail Short-Sleeve T-Shirt
description: Infuse your everyday casual wardrobe with a touch of sparkle with this Amati logo graphic t-shirt. Crafted from ultra-soft, breathable cotton in a delicate pastel pink hue, this piece turns a classic basic into a standout fashion statement.The front showcases the signature "AMATI" branding across the chest, anchored by a dramatic, oversized letter "A" meticulously embellished with shimmering micro-sequins and dark rhinestones. Designed with a timeless crew neckline, short sleeves, and a regular fit, it offers a comfortable silhouette that layers beautifully. Pair it with dark-wash skinny jeans and white sneakers for an effortless, high-contrast weekend look.

description: Introduce modern elegance to your collection with the beautifully contoured PINKO Click Soft Horizontal Shoulder Bag. name: Medium Suede Crossbody Boston Bag
